title: Apple Butter in the Oven
description: This baked apple butter in the oven recipe offers an easy alternative to stovetop cooking, using a low oven temperature instead of constant stirring.
ingredients: 4 pounds apples - peeled, cored, and chopped

steps.text: Combine apples, apple cider, sugar, and salt together in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add cinnamon, star anise, allspice, and cloves. Bring to a simmer. Cover partially and cook until apples are soft, 20 to 25 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F (135 degrees C).

Remove and discard allspice and cloves with a slotted spoon. Remove and reserve cinnamon and star anise. Purée apples with an immersion blender until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and reserved cinnamon and star anise.

Bake uncovered in the preheated oven, stirring every 30 minutes, until mixture thickens and deepens in color, about 3 hours total. Let cool completely. Discard cinnamon and star anise before transferring to airtight containers.
